summary: Retest of the iteration_21 fixes. All pass. Backend: 15 of 15 pytest pass (5 new tests in test_promo_fixes_it22.py plus 10 regression tests in test_vip_promos_profile.py). Checked: POST /bets/{id}/auto-cashout on a free bet returns 400 'Free bets can't be cashed out' for both a target and null, and nothing is stored. Void and cashed_out bets are excluded from wagered, VIP points and wagering remaining; this was checked with mongo status flips and also with a real cash-out through the API (3x sports weighting confirmed: $12 staked = 36 pts, 12 pts after void + cash-out). Bonus tx carries the label 'Promo CODE'. Frontend: wallet 'Promo UI..CASH +$20.00' shows in green; free bet txs show 'Free Bet Placed $10.00' in grey with no sign; a normal bet shows -$2.00. My Bets: FREE BET badge (history-free-bet-{id}) on free bets only; open $10 free bet at 2.35 shows To win $13.50 (winnings only); won $5 free bet shows Payout $6.75 (b.payout); free bets show no buttons, so no cash-out or auto cash-out, while the normal bet still has Cash out and Set auto cash out. Admin promo form shows labels Code, Reward type, Amount $, Match %, Max bonus $, Wagering (× bonus), Max uses, Expires (optional), and the fields switch correctly by type (wagering hidden for free bets). Created cash, free_bet, deposit_match (with expiry) and cash codes through the UI; each row appeared with the right reward, wager, uses and expiry. Mobile 390px: brand, wallet, profile link (x 312-340) and logout (x 344-378) are fully inside the viewport, with no horizontal overflow. Profile regression on mobile: name, bonus status 'Wager $18.00 more' is correct, the redeem toast shows '$1.00 added', the header balance goes from $18 to $19 and the wagering remaining from 18 to 19.

minor.issue: The admin 'Wagered' column sums all non-free bets, including void and cashed_out ones, so it no longer matches the player's profile wagered or the wagering calculation.
Sports stakes are summed raw, without coin conversion (casino converts with rates). Legacy non-USD bets (b.coin != USD is still handled in the UI) would be miscounted.

issues: The floating support/headset button sits over the top-right corner of the promo 'Redeem' button area when scrolled to the promo box.
For non-USD bets the <Usd> secondary value still uses potential_payout (not winnings-only for free bets, and not b.payout for won bets). Edge case only.

context_for_next_testing_agent: pytest.ini uses xdist (-n), so don't pass -p no:xdist. The cashout endpoint needs the body {expected: quote}. seed_ui_it22.py seeds a UI player (cash promo, open and won free bets, normal bet) into /tmp/seed_ui_it22.json; run 'python seed_ui_it22.py clean' to remove it. The admin promo form is on the /admin page. Log in from the browser with fetch('/api/auth/login', credentials:'include') and then reload.
